firefox.best_for: Users who prioritize privacy, security, and open-source software in their web browsing experience, and those who appreciate extensive customization options.
firefox.free_tier: Firefox is entirely free and open-source.
firefox.limitations: As a fully open-source project, there are no 'free tier' limitations. Its functionality is consistent across all users.
firefox.licensing_notes: Firefox is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, making it free for all use, including commercial purposes.

faq.question: Is Firefox a free web browser?
faq.answer: Yes, Firefox is a completely free and open-source web browser.

faq.question: Can I use Firefox in a business environment without cost?
faq.answer: Yes, Firefox is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, which allows free use for all purposes, including commercial use.

vlc-media-player.summary: VLC Media Player is a free and open-source multimedia player that can play almost all multimedia files, as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and various streaming protocols.
vlc-media-player.what_it_does: VLC plays a wide range of audio and video formats without needing additional codecs. It also supports streaming, converting media, and playing incomplete files.
vlc-media-player.best_for: Individuals looking for a versatile, free, and robust media player that handles nearly any audio or video file format without hassle.
vlc-media-player.free_tier: VLC Media Player is entirely free and open-source.
vlc-media-player.limitations: As a fully open-source project, there are no 'free tier' limitations on its core functionality. The notes specify 'free for home/personal use', implying potential restrictions for commercial use.
vlc-media-player.licensing_notes: VLC Media Player is licensed under LGPL, and the notes specify it is 'free for home/personal use'. Users should check the official documentation for specific commercial use permissions.

faq.question: Is VLC Media Player free?
faq.answer: Yes, VLC Media Player is free and open-source, specifically noted as free for home and personal use.

faq.question: Can I use VLC Media Player for commercial purposes?
faq.answer: The notes indicate it is free for home/personal use. For specific commercial use permissions, users should check the official documentation and licensing details.

zoom.summary: Zoom is a popular video conferencing platform used for online meetings, webinars, and chat. It offers a free tier for personal use with certain limitations, alongside paid plans.
zoom.what_it_does: Zoom enables users to host and join video calls, share screens, and communicate via chat, facilitating remote collaboration and virtual events.
zoom.best_for: Individuals and small groups needing a straightforward solution for personal video calls and online meetings, especially for short durations.
zoom.free_tier: Zoom offers a free tier for personal use.
zoom.limitations: The free tier has a known time limit on group calls. For specific details on this and other potential limitations, users should check the official documentation.
zoom.licensing_notes: Zoom offers a free tier for personal use. Paid plans are available for extended features, longer meeting durations, and business functionalities. Users should consult the official website for detailed licensing and plan information.

faq.question: Is Zoom completely free to use?
faq.answer: Zoom offers a free tier for personal use, which comes with certain limitations. Paid plans are available for more extensive features.

faq.question: What are the limitations of Zoom's free tier?
faq.answer: The free tier has a known time limit on group calls. For full details on all limitations, please check the official Zoom documentation.

slack.summary: Slack is a widely used messaging application for team collaboration, offering channels for organized communication, direct messaging, and file sharing. It provides a free tier with limitations, alongside paid plans.
slack.what_it_does: Slack facilitates real-time communication within teams, allowing users to create channels for different topics, share files, and integrate with other business tools.
slack.best_for: Small teams and individuals who need a structured messaging platform for internal communication and project coordination, especially for casual or non-archival discussions.
slack.free_tier: Slack offers a free tier for personal and small team use.
slack.limitations: The free tier has known message history limits. For specific details on this and other potential limitations, users should check the official documentation.
slack.licensing_notes: Slack offers a free tier for personal and small team use. Paid plans are available for extended features, unlimited message history, and advanced administrative controls. Users should consult the official website for detailed licensing and plan information.

faq.question: Is Slack free for teams?
faq.answer: Slack offers a free tier suitable for small teams and personal use, but it comes with certain limitations. Paid plans provide more features and fewer restrictions.

notion.summary: Notion is an all-in-one workspace that combines notes, databases, wikis, calendars, and reminders. It offers a free personal plan, with paid plans available for teams and advanced features.
notion.what_it_does: Notion allows users to create highly customizable pages and workspaces for organizing information, managing projects, taking notes, and building personal wikis.
notion.best_for: Individuals and students looking for a flexible and versatile tool to organize their personal life, studies, or small projects, combining various productivity functions into one platform.
notion.free_tier: Notion offers a free personal plan.
notion.limitations: The free personal plan may have limitations on file uploads, guest access, or version history compared to paid plans. Users should check the official documentation for specific differences.
notion.licensing_notes: Notion offers a free personal plan. Paid plans are available for teams, increased storage, and advanced features. Users should consult the official website for detailed licensing and plan information.

obs-studio.summary: OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster Software) is a free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming. It is widely used for broadcasting gameplay, presentations, and other content.
obs-studio.what_it_does: OBS Studio allows users to capture video and audio from multiple sources, mix them, and broadcast the output live to platforms like Twitch and YouTube, or save it as a local recording.
obs-studio.best_for: Streamers, content creators, educators, and anyone needing a powerful, free tool for live streaming or recording high-quality video content.
obs-studio.free_tier: OBS Studio is entirely free and open-source.
obs-studio.limitations: As a fully open-source project, there are no 'free tier' limitations. Its functionality is consistent across all users.
obs-studio.licensing_notes: OBS Studio is licensed under the GNU General Public License (GPL), making it free for all use, including commercial purposes.

faq.question: Is OBS Studio completely free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, OBS Studio is entirely free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming.
